concepts.question: Is a discrete focal area standing out from the surrounding layered tissue visible?

absent.text: only smooth parallel layers of fat, fibroglandular tissue and muscle, with nothing standing out from them

equivocal.text: a faint textural variation whose outline cannot be traced all the way round on this single view

present.text: a discrete area whose full outline can be traced, occupying space and pushing the layers aside

concepts.question: If a focal area stands out, is its outline oval, gently lobulated, or jagged?

no_focal_area.text: no traceable outline anywhere in the frame; the fibroglandular layers run uninterrupted across it

oval_or_round.text: a smooth ellipse or circle whose outline curves evenly, with no bulges and no corners

gently_lobulated.text: two or three broad rounded bulges on an otherwise smooth ellipse, each bulge wide and shallow

irregular.text: outline neither round nor oval: jagged or angular, or studded with many tiny 1-2 mm lobulations

concepts.question: If a focal area stands out, is its boundary sharp, blurred, or angular and spiky?

no_focal_area.text: nothing stands out from the tissue layers, so there is no boundary anywhere to judge

circumscribed.text: the whole circumference is a sharp line with an abrupt transition to the tissue around it

indistinct.text: part of the edge fades into the surrounding tissue with no sharp line separating the two

angular_or_spiculated.text: the edge forms sharp corners, or fine straight lines radiate outward from it into the tissue

concepts.question: Does any focal area reach deeper below the skin than it measures across?

absent.text: width across the image clearly exceeds depth, or nothing discrete stands out to measure at all

borderline.text: depth below the skin line and width across it look about equal, neither axis clearly the longer

present.text: the area reaches further in depth from the skin line than it measures across, standing upright

concepts.question: Is tissue directly beneath a focal area darker than tissue beside it at that depth?

absent.text: tissue just deep to the area is as bright as tissue at the same depth beside it

mild.text: narrow dark lines trail from the area's edges only; tissue directly behind it stays visible

marked.text: a broad dark band deep to the whole area hides the tissue behind it toward the image bottom

concepts.question: Is a broad bright rim, thicker than a fine line, present around a focal area?

absent.text: no bright rim, or only a hairline bright capsule no thicker than the surrounding tissue lines

mild.text: a bright rim clearly thicker than a hairline but present around only part of the circumference

marked.text: a broad bright zone right around the area, its outer edge fading gradually into surrounding tissue

concepts.question: Are the horizontal tissue layers around a focal area pulled in or interrupted?

absent.text: the horizontal tissue layers run straight past the area, neither bent toward it nor broken

mild.text: layers next to the area bow or angle toward it but remain continuous along their length

marked.text: layers are broken where they meet the area, with straight strands running radially out from it
